objective: Final original-to-unified preservation review after executable examples and corrected architecture/implementation assumptions.

historical_evidence.policy: Historical verdicts are not relabeled current. All326 current source states were freshly judged.

coverage.instructions: Compare only the supplied original official fragment with the mapped CURRENT curated counterparts. Preserve actionable contracts, constraints, warnings, example intent and useful resource links; identifiers may be renamed to make examples valid. An explicit pinned-SDK/runtime-backed correction is valid curation, not a requirement to repeat an upstream mistake. Classify this fragment, not unrelated changes elsewhere in a whole guide. Headings/frontmatter/navigation alone are organizational.

criteria.covered: All substantive instructions in THIS source fragment are accurately retained.
criteria.organizational: This fragment is metadata, navigation or a heading with no missing substantive contract.
criteria.curated: A specific statement in THIS fragment is explicitly corrected or qualified by pinned implementation/runtime evidence.
criteria.gap: A substantive source contract is omitted or incorrectly replaced.
criteria.other: The supplied evidence cannot support a decision.

rubric_hash_serialization: json.dumps(full_rubric, sort_keys=True), default separators/ASCII, no trailing newline

accounting.line_union: All1..N lines of every original file accounted for without exclusion. source_lines, not historical ID suffixes, are authoritative.

input_recipe.normalization: UTF-8 read_text().splitlines();1-based inclusive ranges;join with LF, no added trailing LF.
input_recipe.order: Listed counterpart_excerpts order. SHA256 of complete concatenated UTF-8 state.

clean_install.scope: Clean lockfile installation followed by explicit better-sqlite3 rebuild; no dependency lifecycle skill installation.

offline.boundary: Actual SDK algorithms with explicit finite model/protocol fixtures; expected negative paths are asserted, not suppressed.

leaf_discovery.boundary: Actual local distribution-leaf discovery, not bare-repository discovery or an installation mutation.

actual_page_refresh.capability: Unavailable on this device/profile. Check Chrome hardware, storage and Prompt API prerequisites. No browser model was exercised.
actual_page_refresh.status: Browser entry loaded. Capability inspection does not start a model download.

browser.boundary: Built/loaded actual browser entry; unavailable state and disabled controls verified. No download/inference.

runner_guards.boundary: Throwaway exact copied runner; owned loopback and artificial secret. Live-mode budget check is not live provider inference. Deadline timing accelerated; not a real 120-second endurance test.

live.boundary: Fresh bounded provider acceptance on synthetic application data. Not a model-quality benchmark; broader earlier unretained observations are not included.

claim_boundary: Preserves official TypeScript snapshot contracts with explicit source/runtime-backed curation. No generated-language runtime parity, all-provider quality, live audio/image/browser inference, production durability or exactly-once guarantee.

final_original_to_unified_review.method: Fresh exhaustive Jev pass, parent review of every flag plus changed source deltas and organizational/curation scope; current source/destination hashes and exact inclusive spans retained.
